privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: FRONTROW is an independent, fan-made project that aggregates public women's sports data. This page explains simply what we do — and mostly don't do — with your data.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: FRONTROW doesn't require an account, an email, or a password. Your preferred display language (French, English, or Spanish) is stored locally on your device. If you connect your TikTok account to post a video, we keep an anonymous session identifier (a technical cookie, no personal data) and, encrypted on our servers, the TikTok access tokens needed to post on your behalf — never your TikTok password, which we never see.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: The site doesn't use any advertising or tracking cookies. It uses your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember your language, and, only if you connect TikTok, a technical cookie (httpOnly, secure) that identifies your session for as long as you use that feature.

sections.title: TikTok connection
sections.body: If you choose to connect your TikTok account, FRONTROW uses TikTok Login Kit (OAuth): you authenticate directly on tiktok.com, never on our site. The access and refresh tokens TikTok returns are encrypted (AES-256) before being stored, and are only used for actions you trigger yourself (posting a video, checking your account info). You can disconnect your account at any time from the Settings page, which revokes access and deletes those tokens.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: To show scores, standings, and stats, your browser queries ESPN's public API directly — as with any site loading an external resource, this exposes your IP address to ESPN. The site also loads fonts (Google Fonts) and icons (Font Awesome via Cloudflare) from external CDNs, and uses Upstash (database hosting) to store active TikTok connections. Links to our Instagram and TikTok accounts point to those platforms but don't drop any tracker on our pages.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: The site is served over HTTPS, which encrypts traffic between your browser and our servers.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: If you've never connected TikTok, we keep almost no data server-side. If you have, you can delete the stored tokens at any time by clicking "Disconnect" in Settings. For any other privacy question, you can reach us via our Instagram account @frontrow.sport.

sections.title: Children
sections.body: FRONTROW is a general-audience sports information site. We don't knowingly collect personal data about minors.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may change as the site evolves (new features, new partners). The update date at the top of this page reflects the latest version.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using FRONTROW, you agree to the terms below. If something here doesn't work for you, the best move is not to use the site and to let us know.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: FRONTROW is an independent, unofficial project made by a fan of women's sports. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with any of the leagues or bodies shown (WNBA, NCAA, FIBA, the International Olympic Committee) or with ESPN, whose public data is used for informational purposes.

sections.title: Data accuracy
sections.body: Scores, standings, statistics, and schedules come from ESPN's public API and are shown "as is", with no guarantee of accuracy, completeness, or real-time updates. Don't rely on FRONTROW for sports betting or any decision that requires an official source.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: Team names, logos, trademarks, and visuals shown belong to their respective owners (leagues, federations, clubs) and are used solely for identification and informational purposes, with no intent to claim any right over them.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: FRONTROW is intended for personal, non-commercial use. Bulk scraping of the content, disrupting the service, or misusing the site in any way is not permitted.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: The site contains links to third-party services (ESPN, Instagram, TikTok). FRONTROW isn't responsible for the content, policies, or practices of those external sites.

sections.title: TikTok connection and posting
sections.body: Connecting TikTok and posting videos are optional features, triggered only by you. By using them, you confirm you hold all necessary rights to the content posted and remain subject to TikTok's own Terms of Service and Community Guidelines. FRONTROW isn't responsible for the moderation, distribution, or availability of your content once posted to TikTok.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, FRONTROW isn't liable for damages resulting from the use, or inability to use, the site.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated as the site evolves. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the new terms.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, you can reach us via our Instagram account @frontrow.sport.
